title: 1:1 prep - Taylor Nguyen
content:
Meeting context:
- Weekly 1:1 with Avery (manager). Focus: status updates, blockers, career check-in, and alignment on Q2 goals for serving runtime.
- Time: 30 minutes.
- Goal for this 1:1: confirm rollout plan for KV cache improvement, triage perf regression, and set career next steps (stretch project or mentorship).

Agenda (draft):
1) Quick status (5m)
   - What shipped since last 1:1: prototype KV cache sharding landed to staging, basic benchmarks look promising (~8-12% tail latency improvement for 8k tokens).
   - Current focus: e2e testing of cache eviction policy + canary rollout plan.
2) Blockers & risks (10m)
   - Flaky integration test with quantized kernel on g4dn instances (failure rate ~6% in nightly). Suspect race in KV cache invalidation when model reloads under load.
   - Need decision on rollout gating: do we require 48h of green e2e or canary with 0.5% traffic first?
   - Infra quota issue: Dedicated test pool CPU quotas exhausted in us-west1; blocked for large scale load tests.
3) Metrics and success criteria (5m)
   - Target: reduce p95 decode latency by 10% for long-context flows without increasing cost per token > 2%.
   - Observability: add a tag to traces indicating cache hit/miss and track hit ratio vs latency.
4) Career / growth (5m)
   - Discuss interest in leading a cross-team mini-project on batching heuristics for Q3.
   - Feedback request: seeking guidance on presentation skills for upcoming brown-bag.
5) Action items & next steps (remaining time)

Notes to self (things I want to bring up):
- Mention that the perf regression seen in canary yesterday correlates with a kernel change in PR #847; I think we can roll back that kernel while we iterate. Reference GH PR in notes.
- Ask about priority trade-offs: Dedicated customer demo scheduled mid-April — do we prioritize stability over new optimization work?
- Request for 1:1: a short peer intro to Linda from observability to help instrument cache metrics.

Current status summary:
- KV cache sharding: proto merged to staging, e2e failing intermittently (integration tests).
- Benchmark numbers: staged workloads show 8-12% p95 improvement in synthetic workloads; production-like workloads show smaller gain (~4-6%) due to lower cache hit rate. Need better prefix caching for real traffic.
- Oncall: covered last oncall; no long-running incidents but noticed increased error rate correlated with kernel change. Filed JIRA RDW-1423.

Blockers (explicit asks for manager):
- Need a quick thumbs on rollout gating policy (48h green vs 0.5% canary). Prefer canary with 0.5% traffic + auto-rollback on error spike — ask for approval.
- Assistance with infra quota: can Avery escalate with infra to get temporary CPU quota in us-west1 for large-scale tests?
- Introduce me to Linda in observability for help with trace tagging.

Proposed action items (post-1:1) - put owner and rough deadline in notes:
- (Taylor) Add cache-hit trace tag and dashboard card for hit ratio + p95 latency; target 2026-03-05.
- (Taylor) Open a rollback PR for kernel change if we confirm regression in next canary; target 2026-03-03 (contingent on canary results).
- (Avery) Approve canary rollout policy (0.5% with auto-rollback) or confirm need for 48h green; target 2026-03-02.
- (Avery) Contact infra to request temporary CPU quota bump in us-west1 for RDW-1423 testing; provide expected quota numbers by EOD.
- (Avery) Introduce Linda (observability) via Slack for brief sync; target 2026-03-04.

Career / development items to discuss:
- Interest: lead Q3 batching heuristics mini-project — scope: propose experiment matrix, own implementation plan, coordinate with batching service and runtime teams.
- Ask for feedback on communication: want to improve slide structure for brown-bag, ask for 1:1 feedback or a dry run session.

Followups from last 1:1 (status):
- Action: document canary plan for KV cache (Taylor) — DONE, shared link in GH PR template.
- Action: pair with Priya on e2e tests — scheduled for 2026-02-28, still pending (rescheduled due to priorities).

Misc notes / personal reminders:
- Keep PRs small for kernel changes; add canary flags where possible.
- Bring sample metrics to meeting (p95 numbers and hit ratio graphs).
- Prep a 2-minute summary of the perf tradeoffs for the customer demo team.

End of notes.
